description: Self-hosted studio for generating, verifying, reviewing and publishing Instagram carousels.
//overrides: Next bundles its own copies of these and its advisory range covers every
published version, so there is no in-range fix to wait for.
sharp: four libvips CVEs (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj). Next only uses sharp for
next/image, which this app does not use — but an unused vulnerable native
library still ships in the runtime image, so it gets pinned rather than
postcss: build-time only, and it processes our own stylesheets rather than
anything an attacker supplies. Pinned because the fix is free, not because
IMPORTANT, and the reason this note is long: these overrides only pin the
TOP-LEVEL copies. They do not reach next's own nested ones — verified by
re-resolving the lockfile, which still places sharp 0.34.5 and postcss
8.4.31 under node_modules/next/node_modules. npm will not apply an
override to a dependency the parent declares optional, and adding a
nested `next: {...}` entry does not change that.
So `npm audit` reports high findings that this block cannot fix, and the
runtime fix is physical: apps/web/Dockerfile deletes both from the image.
